newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi wins weather system order for KL airport.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi wins weather system order for KL airport.

text.p: An international consortium comprising Mitsubishi Electric Corp, Mitsubishi Corp and a Malaysian firm won an order to provide a meteorological system to Kuala Lumpur International Airport, Mitsubishi Electric said on Tuesday.
The order is worth more than $19 million, it said.
The Malaysian firm is XYBase Technologies, a Mitsubishi Electric spokesman said.
The consortium was set up in September 1996 to provide equipment and overall management for the project, he added.

The system consists of Meteorological Doppler Radar which provides real-time meteorological information and warnings to users of the new airport for operations, weather briefings and flight planning purposes, the company said in a statement.
Mitsubishi Electric worked with U.S. firms Atmospheric Environmental Research Inc and Sigmet Inc to develop the equipment, it added.
